**Roles:** Infrastructure and Systems Engineer, DevOps Engineer<br>
**Model:** Oss<br>
**Status:** Active

Machine emulator and virtualizer supporting full-system emulation, user-mode emulation, and hardware-assisted virtualization.

**Use when**

- You need cross-architecture emulation, virtual-machine device models, or KVM-accelerated virtual machines.

**Consider alternatives when**

- You require a complete multi-host virtualization management platform rather than a virtualization engine.

[Official site](https://www.qemu.org/) · [Documentation](https://www.qemu.org/docs/master/) · [Source repository](https://github.com/qemu/qemu)

### Rackula

**Categories:** Virtualization, bare metal and homelab<br>
**Roles:** Infrastructure and Systems Engineer, DevOps Engineer<br>
**Model:** Oss<br>
**Status:** Active

Browser-based rack layout designer for planning equipment placement and exporting rack diagrams.

**Use when**

- You need a lightweight visual record or draft layout for physical rack equipment.

**Consider alternatives when**

- You need a full DCIM system with discovery
- cabling
- capacity
- and asset lifecycle integration.

[Official site](https://www.racku.la/) · [Source repository](https://github.com/RackulaLives/Rackula)

**Categories:** Virtualization, bare metal and homelab<br>
**Roles:** DevOps Engineer, Infrastructure and Systems Engineer<br>
**Model:** Oss<br>
**Status:** Needs Review

Desktop Kubernetes and container management.

**Use when**

- You want a free, open-source Docker Desktop alternative with built-in K8s.

**Consider alternatives when**

### RootlessKit

**Roles:** DevOps Engineer, Infrastructure and Systems Engineer<br>
**Model:** Oss<br>

Rootless container toolkit.

### runc

**Categories:** Virtualization, bare metal and homelab<br>
**Roles:** DevOps Engineer, Infrastructure and Systems Engineer<br>
**Model:** Oss<br>
**Status:** Needs Review

OCI runtime for containers.

### Sustainable Computing (Kepler)

**Categories:** Virtualization, bare metal and homelab<br>
**Roles:** DevOps Engineer, Infrastructure and Systems Engineer<br>
**Model:** Oss<br>

Power consumption monitoring for Kubernetes (project ecosystem).

### Technitium DNS Server

**Categories:** Virtualization, bare metal and homelab<br>
**Roles:** Infrastructure and Systems Engineer, Cloud Security Engineer<br>
**Model:** Oss<br>
**Status:** Active

Self-hosted authoritative and recursive DNS server with an administrative web interface and blocking capabilities.

**Use when**

- You need a self-hosted DNS server covering authoritative zones
- recursion
- forwarding
- and lab or small-network administration.

**Consider alternatives when**

- You require a vendor-managed global DNS service or established enterprise support contracts.

[Official site](https://technitium.com/dns/) · [Source repository](https://github.com/TechnitiumSoftware/DnsServer)

### Ventoy

**Categories:** Virtualization, bare metal and homelab<br>
**Roles:** Infrastructure and Systems Engineer, DevOps Engineer<br>
**Model:** Oss<br>
**Status:** Active

Bootable USB tool that launches ISO, WIM, IMG, VHD, and EFI images directly from copied files.

**Use when**

- You maintain multi-image boot media for provisioning
- recovery
- or hardware diagnostics.

**Consider alternatives when**

- Secure-boot policy or supply-chain controls require vendor-certified single-purpose installation media.

[Official site](https://www.ventoy.net/) · [Source repository](https://github.com/ventoy/Ventoy)

### Volare

**Categories:** Virtualization, bare metal and homelab<br>
**Roles:** DevOps Engineer, Infrastructure and Systems Engineer<br>
**Model:** Oss<br>
**Status:** Needs Review

Kubernetes volume populator that populates Persistent Volume Claims (PVCs) from multiple external sources concurrently.

**Use when**

- You need to pre-populate PVCs from multiple sources (S3, Git, HTTP) before pod startup.

**Consider alternatives when**

- Your volumes are provisioned by CSI drivers or init containers suffice.

[Source repository](https://github.com/AdamShannag/volare)

### WinBoat

**Categories:** Developer experience and local environments, Virtualization, bare metal and homelab<br>
**Roles:** Developer Experience Engineer, Infrastructure and Systems Engineer<br>
**Model:** Oss<br>
**Status:** Active

Linux desktop application that runs Windows in a managed virtual machine with integrated applications and filesystem access.

**Use when**

**Consider alternatives when**

- You need native performance
- enterprise VDI governance
- or a supported Windows server virtualization platform.
